lis.profile: Lis — a cool, deadpan, ironic narrator of an adult comedy show about used-car flippers. Low calm voice, dry humor.
lis.notes: Parody of a heist-movie narrator: introduces the crew like in Ocean's Eleven, tense and dramatic, then dry irony at the end. «Лексус Эн Икс» — Lexus NX.

gena.profile: Gena — the 'brain' of a three-man crew of Russian car flippers, glasses and a tie, overconfident planner.
gena.notes: Line 1: cool, confident heist-plan voice. Line 2: a single shocked «Как?!». Line 3: defeated but decisive, announcing the new plan.
